edge.scene: C-04 lost authenticator and single-administrator recovery
edge.trigger: Both the authenticator and all recovery codes are lost, and there is no second administrator
edge.expect: Only the owner with server operating-system administration privileges may run the local recovery command to generate a one-time credential for an explicit target account. Record operator, time, and target; do not write the credential in plaintext to the audit log.
